description: This week, Emerge launched Faces of NAM (#SayNAM) featuring Emerge alumnae across the country. Colorado State Rep. Naquetta Ricks, a Democrat who represents the diverse community of Aurora, shared her story on what it was like to represent the New American Majority.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Naquetta Ricks for Colorado
title: Faces of the New American Majority: Rep. Naquetta Ricks — State Representative Naquetta Ricks HD40
